in_memory_sha256_macos_arm64.method: Twelve alternating pairs comparing published and local hybrid-array 0.4.15. Both use the same local sha2 and block-buffer. Each digest matched Python hashlib.

signed_mac_archives.method: Six alternating Mac pairs per archive, including verified completion, against the previous app.

signed_mac_reader.method: Forty-two previews and twelve MHTML exports per build. The historical native lane uses libzim. Published is the previous signed Rust app. Preview and normalized wire outputs matched.
signed_mac_reader.clock: elapsed nanoseconds per local command, including JSON, IPC and filesystem output for MHTML

scratch_native_blocks_macos_arm64.method: Separate prototype, absent from these app packages. Twelve alternating pairs with local hybrid-array in both lanes, comparing the legacy SHA-256 path against native-block streaming. Each digest matched Python hashlib.
